EasyCrypt/easycrypt::1059::Stronger prec.summary: The pRHL tactics `eager-seq` and `eager-while` now accept a stronger (more general) precondition.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::1063::typing: defer.summary: Deferred failed-application classification in the type-checker for performance improvement.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::1064::feat: print a.summary: Added support for printing an individual procedure using `print [proc] M.p`.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::849::reduce when ne.repair_hint: If PHL tactics like `proc`, `call`, `inline`, or `rnd` now succeed on goals involving operator definitions where they previously failed, or vice versa, this change in reduction behavior is the likely cause.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::851::Make casts fro.summary: Casting from single-sided to two-sided formulas in `conseq`/`app` now uses a more robust pattern.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::853::Remove dead-co.summary: Removed dead code from the theory cloning implementation.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::852::Kill warnings.summary: Killed compiler warnings and unified dune build flags for CI and development environments.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::856::Also swap memo.summary: Fixed the symmetry tactic to also swap memory types when swapping memories.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::856::Also swap memo.repair_hint: If `symmetry` previously succeeded but now fails or produces different goals due to memory type mismatches, this bug fix is the likely cause.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::857::In matching, d.summary: Fixed the matching engine to avoid unifying a memory variable with itself.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::857::In matching, d.repair_hint: If pattern matching in PHL tactics behaves differently (e.g., previously succeeds but now fails or vice versa), this fix to self-unification of memories may be the cause.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::858::Improve error.summary: Improved the error message produced when a top-assumption rewrite fails.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::860::When doing sec.summary: Fixed section analysis to recurse into operator bodies when computing section dependencies.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::860::When doing sec.repair_hint: If a proof using sections fails because an operator used inside another operator is not recognized as a section dependency, this fix is the likely cause; ensure the EasyCrypt version includes this fix.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::866::When doing sec.repair_hint: If a proof using sections fails because a type defined in terms of another type is not recognized as a section dependency, this fix is the likely cause.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::862::Fix dependency.summary: Fixed a bug in the dependency analysis logic within the module and section system.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::862::Fix dependency.repair_hint: If proofs involving modules or sections fail with unexpected dependency errors, this fix may resolve them.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::867::Build: unify r.summary: Unified compiler warning flags between release and development builds.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::840::[docker] updat.summary: Updated Docker build files and added a Formosa-specific Docker image.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::559::[eco]: add a c.summary: Added a compilation trace feature to the eco mode that records messages and goals.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::869::Fixing the fre.summary: Fixed a bug where the free memory set of the second goal generated by `byehoare` was computed incorrectly.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::869::Fixing the fre.repair_hint: If `byehoare` goals have unexpected free-variable or memory issues, this fix may resolve them; check that the second goal's memory assumptions are now correct.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::787::New lazy/eager.repair_hint: If proofs using `eager` tactics or the PROM/SDist theories break, inspect changes to the eager/lazy tactic syntax and semantics and update proof scripts accordingly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::868::Refman skeleto.summary: Created the skeleton structure for the EasyCrypt reference manual with Sphinx documentation infrastructure.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::811::Positivity che.summary: Added positivity checking for type constructors in inductive type declarations.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::811::Positivity che.repair_hint: If a proof script defines an inductive type that was previously accepted but now fails, check whether the type constructor violates the positivity condition and revise the type definition.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::872::fix alpha-conv.summary: Fixed alpha-conversion bugs in the ehoare program logic tactics.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::872::fix alpha-conv.repair_hint: If ehoare proofs involving variable binding or substitution fail, this fix may resolve alpha-conversion-related issues; re-run affected ehoare proof steps.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::876::Revert typecla.summary: Reverted previously added typeclass features from the EasyCrypt source.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::876::Revert typecla.repair_hint: If proof scripts relied on recently added typeclass syntax or functionality, those features have been removed and the scripts will need to be rewritten without them.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::870::Allow substitu.summary: Allowed the `subst` tactic to substitute local variables that share the memory used by a `Pr` expression, fixing and extending substitution in probabilistic contexts.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::870::Allow substitu.repair_hint: If proofs using `subst` near `Pr` expressions changed behavior, check whether previously failing substitutions now succeed or whether previously succeeding ones behave differently due to this breaking change.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::875::[documentation.summary: Added documentation for the `if` tactic to the reference manual.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::878::[seq]: remove.summary: Removed the backward/forward (`bck`/`fwd`) option from the `seq` tactic and performed related cleanup.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::878::[seq]: remove.repair_hint: If proof scripts use `seq` with a `bck` or `fwd` option, that syntax has been removed and those arguments must be deleted or the tactic rewritten.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::882::proofnav: impr.summary: Improved EasyCrypt error handling in the Sphinx proofnav extension for the reference manual.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::883::ecproofs: add.summary: Added caching and script export functionality to the ecproofs Sphinx extension for proof directives.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::881::[documentation.summary: Documentation was added for the `splitwhile` tactic.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::885::[Internal] Mak.summary: Internal change to make the `|-` and `-|` operators compose in different orders.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::842::Build docker i.summary: CI workflow was added to build Docker images automatically.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::889::[documentation.summary: Documentation was added for the `swap` tactic.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::789::Making program.summary: Program logic formulas were made memory-agnostic, changing how memories are represented and handled throughout the PHL infrastructure.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::789::Making program.repair_hint: Proofs using program logic judgments (hoare, equiv, bdhoare, phoare) may break due to changes in how memory arguments are encoded in formulas; check if memory variables or memory-indexed expressions need to be updated in goal statements and tactic arguments.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::816::Expose memory.summary: Memory bindings in program logic statements are now explicitly exposed in the syntax.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::816::Expose memory.repair_hint: If proof scripts writing or parsing program logic statements (hoare, equiv, etc.) fail to parse, check whether explicit memory binding syntax is now required or has changed form.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::817::address TODOs.summary: Addressed leftover TODOs from the memory softcoding PR (#789) in the AST and PHL consequence/probability modules.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::817::address TODOs.repair_hint: If proofs using conseq or probability-related tactics broke after PR #789, this fix may resolve them; re-run proofs against the updated version.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::820::Fix some regre.summary: Fixed regressions introduced by PR #789 in reduction and denotational semantics modules.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::820::Fix some regre.repair_hint: If proofs broken by PR #789 still fail, this regression fix may address reduction or deno-tactic failures; re-test after applying this patch.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::822::Removing spuri.summary: Removed spurious print statements from the MSet and SDist theory files.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::823::Feature: Addin.summary: Added a new statement-level procedure change tactic for rewriting programs at the statement level.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::823::Feature: Addin.repair_hint: Proofs that previously worked around the lack of statement-level proc change may now be expressible directly; if a related tactic name or syntax is not found, check for the new proc change tactic introduced here.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::824::Add lemmas for.summary: New lemmas for list count and perm_eq were added to the List theory.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::824::Add lemmas for.repair_hint: If a proof needs facts about list count or perm_eq that were missing, these new lemmas may now provide them directly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::826::Fix comparison.summary: Fixed a bug in the comparison of fixpoint declarations during theory replay and substitution.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::826::Fix comparison.repair_hint: If proofs involving fixpoint definitions fail to check or replay across theory cloning/instantiation, this bug fix may resolve the issue.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::828::Ident printing.summary: Fixed bugs in identifier printing in the environment and formula printing modules.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::831::Proc change mu.summary: Extended the proc change tactic to support multiline ranges and deep code positions.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::831::Proc change mu.repair_hint: If proc change tactic invocations with range or position arguments fail to parse or apply, check the updated syntax for specifying ranges and deep code positions.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::809::Library for ke.summary: Added a new library for keyed-hash functions as a new theory file.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::810::Library for tw.summary: Added a new library for tweakable hash functions as a new theory file.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::821::recover UC exa.summary: Recovered and updated the UC (Universal Composability) example proofs to work with current EasyCrypt.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::794::add Reflection.summary: A new Reflection theory was added to the modules library.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::794::add Reflection.repair_hint: If a proof relies on module reflection lemmas, check whether the new Reflection.eca theory provides the needed results.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::796::List: new lemm.summary: New lemmas nth0, nth1, map1, and head_drop were added to the List theory.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::796::List: new lemm.repair_hint: If a proof needs facts about nth at index 0 or 1, map of a singleton, or head after drop, these new lemmas may be directly applicable.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::795::[tactic] Singl.summary: The single-sided match tactic was fixed to work correctly with arbitrary pre-conditions.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::795::[tactic] Singl.repair_hint: If a proof using single-sided match was failing due to restrictive pre-condition requirements, it may now succeed without changes; if it was relying on old (buggy) behavior, it may need adjustment.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::800::[tactic] Actua.summary: Further robustness improvements were made to the one-sided match tactic.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::800::[tactic] Actua.repair_hint: If one-sided match proofs are failing or behaving unexpectedly, this fix may resolve issues; check whether match goals are now handled more generally.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::683::Rework import.summary: The import mechanism for theories and modules was reworked internally.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::683::Rework import.repair_hint: If proofs fail due to names no longer being in scope or duplicate imports, check whether explicit import or qualified names are now required after this rework.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::781::extend results.summary: Additional lemmas about the ceiling function were added to the Real theory.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::781::extend results.repair_hint: If a proof requires properties of ceil that were previously missing, check the updated Real theory for the new results.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::798::depext -> conf.summary: CI configuration was updated to set depext confirmation level to unsafe-yes.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::724::remove alt-erg.summary: Alt-ergo was removed from the EasyCrypt trusted computing base, requiring proofs previously relying on it to use other solvers.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::724::remove alt-erg.repair_hint: If proofs are failing because alt-ergo is no longer available or trusted, replace alt-ergo calls with another SMT solver (e.g., Z3 or CVC4/CVC5) or add intermediate proof steps.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::797::EcRegexp: PCRE.summary: The internal regexp library was updated from PCRE to PCRE2.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::801::Introduce a sy.summary: A system-wide, parts-oriented configuration file was introduced for EasyCrypt.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::802::OCaml 5 memory.summary: A workaround for an OCaml 5 memory blowup bug in the SMT backend was applied.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::807::List: new lemm.summary: New subsequence-related lemmas were added to the List theory.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::807::List: new lemm.repair_hint: If a proof requires subsequence facts about concatenation, cons, take, or drop, these new lemmas may be directly usable.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::808::Exit --help wi.summary: The --help flag now exits with a non-error (zero) status code.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::815::New result: `L.summary: New lemma `List.sorted_range` was added to the List theory.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::814::More results o.summary: Additional lemmas about `BitEncoding.int2bs` were added to the BitEncoding theory.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::776::fix async whil.summary: A bug in the async while rule was fixed, affecting the `LoopTransform` theory.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::773::[Theories, Spl.summary: The axiom `ofpairK` is no longer required by the `SplitRO` theory.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::778::Update README.summary: The README and INSTALL documentation files were updated.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::780::Fix #761: Sim.summary: The dead-code conditions checked by the `sim` tactic were strengthened to fix incorrectly accepted goals.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::780::Fix #761: Sim.repair_hint: If `sim` now rejects a goal it previously accepted, the dead-code conditions may be stricter; check and strengthen the invariants or conditions supplied to `sim`.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::730::Type annotated.repair_hint: If type-checking of record access expressions fails, check whether type annotations on getters/setters are now required or interact differently with existing code.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::782::Fix bug in SMT.summary: A bug in the SMT translation involving abstraction of non-translatable constructions was fixed.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::782::Fix bug in SMT.repair_hint: If SMT-backed tactics (`smt`, `by smt`) are now failing or succeeding differently, this fix may have changed which goals are sent to the solver; try adjusting SMT hints or lemma instantiations.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::784::Fix indentatio.summary: The indentation of the table of contents in README.md was fixed.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::791::[tactic] Fix t.summary: A type unification bug in the `outline` tactic was fixed.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::669::Add tactic for.summary: A new tactic for proving lossless while loops was added.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::669::Add tactic for.repair_hint: If a proof of losslessness for a while loop is failing, check whether the new dedicated tactic can be applied directly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::713::Extend `clear`.repair_hint: If a proof uses `clear` and now clears more hypotheses than expected (or accepts new forms like `clear *`), adjust subsequent tactic steps that rely on specific context contents.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::728::Improvements t.summary: Improvements were made to module tweaks, including parser and typing changes for fine-grained module definitions.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::728::Improvements t.repair_hint: If proofs involving module definitions or restrictions fail, check whether the module syntax or typing rules have changed and update module expressions accordingly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::727::Reworked outli.summary: The `outline` tactic was reworked with breaking changes affecting its syntax and behavior.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::727::Reworked outli.repair_hint: If proofs using `outline` fail, review the new `outline` tactic syntax and semantics and rewrite those tactic invocations accordingly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::685::New vernacular.summary: A new vernacular command for theory aliases was added to EasyCrypt.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::685::New vernacular.repair_hint: This is a purely additive feature; if a proof fails, check whether existing theory names now conflict with alias names introduced in scope.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::737::Disambiguate p.summary: Precedence in `negbLR` and `negbRL` was disambiguated (breaking change) and new lemmas for left and right distributivity were added to Logic.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::737::Disambiguate p.repair_hint: If proofs using `negbLR` or `negbRL` fail or produce unexpected results, check whether the changed operator precedence affects how these lemmas are applied and add explicit parentheses or rewrite steps as needed.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::722::Multisets.summary: A new multiset library (`MSet`) was added and related theories (FMap, FSet, List, Logic) were updated.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::722::Multisets.repair_hint: If proofs over related datatypes fail, check whether new lemmas or definitions in MSet, FMap, or FSet conflict with existing names in scope.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::751::reduce number.summary: The number of axioms in the `Logic` theory was reduced, turning some axioms into derived lemmas.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::751::reduce number.repair_hint: If proofs that directly reference or rely on specific axiom names in `Logic` fail, check whether those axioms were removed or replaced by proved lemmas and update accordingly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::721::Add list lemma.summary: New list lemmas were added to the `List` theory and some existing proofs were shortened using them.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::757::stdlib: in Fie.summary: A bug was fixed in the `Field` stdlib so that the unit predicate is no longer erased.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::723::Pretty printer.summary: The pretty printer was fixed to print a terminator after module types.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::738::Fix return of.summary: A bug was fixed in the KEM/PKE libraries so that properties with a provided bit are returned correctly.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::738::Fix return of.repair_hint: If proofs using the KEM or PKE crypto libraries fail, check whether the fixed return types or values of properties affect game-based proof steps.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::739::Fix HC collisi.summary: Hash-consing (HC) collision bugs in the AST were fixed.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::743::Minor fixes fo.summary: Minor fixes were applied to the `sim` tactic to correct its behavior.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::743::Minor fixes fo.repair_hint: If proofs using `sim` fail or behave differently, check whether the fixes changed which equivalences `sim` can close automatically and add missing side conditions or intermediate steps.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::734::Hi-level error.summary: Improved error messages are now produced when the `subst` tactic fails.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::748::Hi-level error.summary: Improved error messages are now produced when a `clone` command with an axiom override (`axiom <-`) fails.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::754::fix tactic eho.summary: Fixed a bug in the ehoare if-tactic that constitutes a breaking change to its prior behavior.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::754::fix tactic eho.repair_hint: If proofs using the `ehoare` if-tactic (e.g., `if`-rule applications in ehoare judgments) break, check whether the tactic's generated subgoals or their order have changed and adjust the proof accordingly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::709::[internal] int.summary: Introduced a general mechanism for code position ranges to select code blocks in internal matching and typing infrastructure.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::731::remove duplica.summary: Removed duplicated code from the EcAst module as an internal cleanup.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::616::internals: use.summary: User-defined rewrite rules can now be headed by a projection operator.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::618::cloning: do no.summary: Cloning no longer allows realizing a non-axiomatic lemma (bug fix enforcing correct clone semantics).

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::623::user reduction.summary: Fixed incompleteness issues in user-defined reduction rules during call-by-value and general reduction.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::623::user reduction.repair_hint: If proofs relying on user-defined reduction rules now succeed or fail differently, the fix to reduction completeness may have changed which terms are reduced automatically.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::622::pretty-printer.summary: The pretty-printer output was improved so that it can be re-parsed correctly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::643::make runtest f.summary: The runtest script now fails with a reasonable error message on a bad config filename.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::647::New tactic to.summary: A new tactic was added to alias (introduce a name for) a subexpression of a program instruction.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::655::lexer: do not.summary: The lexer no longer tokenizes decimal numbers in positions where the parser would not accept them.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::655::lexer: do not.repair_hint: If scripts involving decimal literals in unexpected positions now lex or parse differently, adjust the literal syntax to match what the parser expects.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::656::unroll for: co.summary: The `unroll for` tactic now constant-propagates the loop counter, which is a breaking change for proofs depending on the old behavior.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::656::unroll for: co.repair_hint: If proofs using `unroll for` break, account for the fact that the loop counter is now automatically constant-propagated; goals or intermediate states after unrolling may look different.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::657::fix \"unroll f.summary: Fixed a bug where `unroll for` incorrectly raised an InvalidCPos error.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::657::fix \"unroll f.repair_hint: If `unroll for` was previously failing with InvalidCPos, this bug fix should resolve it; no script changes should be needed.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::658::Fix deep code.summary: Fixed parsing of deep code positions in the EasyCrypt parser.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::658::Fix deep code.repair_hint: If a proof using deep code positions (e.g., in inline or rw tactics with position specifiers) fails to parse, check that the position syntax is correct after this fix.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::654::Improve code p.summary: Extended code position syntax to support match expressions and extended assignments.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::654::Improve code p.repair_hint: If a proof using code positions (e.g., for inline or rewriting) breaks, update position specifiers to use the new match/extended-assignment syntax.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::663::Fix include-pa.summary: Fixed include-path management to properly handle duplicate paths in the loader.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::662::add alt-ergo 2.summary: Added alt-ergo 2.6 to the Docker build image.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::667::Track more pre.summary: Improved the sim tactic to track tuple-to-tuple assignments more precisely.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::667::Track more pre.repair_hint: If a proof using the sim tactic on code with tuple assignments breaks or behaves differently, the more precise tracking may require adjusting the equivalence invariants or hints provided to sim.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::673::Fixing code bl.summary: Fixed code block display formatting in the README.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::671::Merge typing o.summary: Merged the typing of expressions and formulas into a unified typing pass.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::671::Merge typing o.repair_hint: If type-checking of expressions or formulas fails after this change, the merged typing may resolve ambiguities differently; try adding explicit type annotations.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::679::Some basic fac.summary: Added basic facts on polynomials and fixed theory cloning in Poly.ec.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::679::Some basic fac.repair_hint: If a proof cloning the Poly theory breaks, the fix to theory cloning may have changed what names are exported; check cloned identifiers.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::675::Tactic `split`.summary: Extended the split tactic to accept a break position argument.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::675::Tactic `split`.repair_hint: If a proof using split breaks, the tactic now accepts an optional position argument; existing uses should still work, but check for parsing ambiguities if split is applied with extra arguments.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::681::get rid of `ax.summary: Replaced uses of 'axiomatized by' with '[opaque]' plus a trivial lemma across standard theories.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::681::get rid of `ax.repair_hint: If a proof relying on 'axiomatized by' definitions in standard theories (Group, FMap, FSet, Distr, Logic, etc.) breaks, replace those patterns with '[opaque]' operator declarations and corresponding trivial lemmas.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::665::Better operato.summary: Improved operator overloading inference during typing.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::665::Better operato.repair_hint: If overloaded operators are now resolved differently (e.g., a previously ambiguous operator now picks a different instance), add explicit type annotations or operator qualifications to disambiguate.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::664::PP: various fi.summary: Applied various fixes to the pretty-printer.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::661::Fine Grained M.summary: Introduced fine-grained module definitions, extending the module definition syntax and typing.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::661::Fine Grained M.repair_hint: If module definitions or proofs about modules fail after this change, review module definition syntax for new fine-grained features and update accordingly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::684::Exposed the tp.summary: Exposed the tp_nothing type policy from EcTyping in its public interface.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::678::More results o.summary: Added more lemmas about floor, ceil, and integer-valued reals (isint) to RealLub.ec and Real.ec.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::678::More results o.repair_hint: If a proof about floor/ceil or isint now finds conflicting or duplicate lemmas, check for name clashes with newly added results in RealLub and Real.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::686::Service commit.summary: Updated Docker, Nix, and Dune build/packaging configuration files.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::687::Service commit.summary: Added the 'explain' flag for Menhir in the Dune build configuration.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::689::Better printin.summary: Improved the display/printing of hint databases in EasyCrypt's output.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::680::Rigid unificat.summary: Added a rigid unification option to the 'hint solve' and 'hint exact' hint database commands.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::680::Rigid unificat.repair_hint: If hint-based automation stops working or behaves differently, check whether the rigid unification option on hint DBs is now required or changes which hints fire.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::690::FMap: add lemm.summary: Added new lemmas about the range of a finite map after an update operation to FMap.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::677::Add PKE librar.summary: Added new PKE (Public Key Encryption) libraries for both the standard model and the ROM.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::672::KEM libraries.summary: Added new KEM (Key Encapsulation Mechanism) libraries for both non-ROM and ROM settings.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::674::Upgrade to why.summary: Upgraded the Why3 backend dependency to version 1.8.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::674::Upgrade to why.repair_hint: If SMT/Why3 discharging of goals fails, check compatibility with Why3 1.8 and update prover configurations accordingly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::693::[external CI].summary: Updated external CI configuration to use the dev branch for XSalsa checks.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::692::Improve transi.summary: Improved the 'transitivity*' and 'replace*' tactics, with breaking changes to their behavior.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::692::Improve transi.repair_hint: If proofs using 'transitivity*' or 'replace*' break, check for updated argument syntax or changed side-condition obligations introduced by this improvement.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::695::Apply cloning.summary: Fixed theory cloning to correctly apply substitutions to datatype constructor types.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::695::Apply cloning.repair_hint: If a proof involving cloning a theory with datatypes breaks or produces unexpected types for constructors, this fix may have changed prior (incorrect) behavior that was being relied upon.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::706::nix: add a dep.summary: Added git as a Nix dependency so that dune-site works correctly.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::708::In matching, f.summary: Fixed a bug in pattern matching to forbid the capture of all variables, preventing unsound matches.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::708::In matching, f.repair_hint: If a proof that previously relied on a pattern match silently capturing all variables now fails, the match pattern needs to be made more explicit.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::707::New code-posit.summary: Added new code-position syntax variants '^()<-' and '^(x)<-' for matching tuple assignment positions.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::707::New code-posit.repair_hint: If code-position expressions in tactics fail to parse, check whether the new tuple-matching position syntax is required or has changed how existing positions are parsed.

EasyCrypt/easycrypt::691::revert subtype.summary: Reworked the Subtype theory and introduced syntactic sugar for cloning it, affecting several dependent theories.
EasyCrypt/easycrypt::691::revert subtype.repair_hint: If proofs using the Subtype theory, ZModP, Word, or Quotient break, check for updated cloning syntax or changed lemma names/structure in the refactored Subtype theory.
